name: Folsom Hall Prayer Room
description:
Prayer room on the second floor of Folsom Hall, with wudu (ablution) stations available to students, faculty, and staff.

The Ummah Resource Map lists Folsom Hall as one of the two campus prayer room locations.

name: University Union Prayer Room
description:
Prayer room on the second floor of the University Union, the Student Union at the center of campus, with wudu (ablution) stations available to students, faculty, and staff.

The Ummah Resource Map lists the Union as one of the two campus prayer room locations.
